semantics.primaryFactor: one open repository-local Issue owns lifecycle for a bounded automation stream
semantics.secondaryFactors: cross-repository, cross-organization and cross-Project Issue references are allowed
semantics.closure: classification never authorizes closing a pull request

unknownAutomation.reason: unreviewed automation identity or identity/branch mismatch

migration.createFactors: one Issue per aggregation key only after ledger review
migration.linking: each retained PR closes or is natively linked to its primary factor; secondary factor references remain additive
migration.historicalPRs: do not close or rewrite solely to improve completeness
